summary.title: Professional Summary
content: Staff Software Engineer with 14 years building fullstack marketplace and SaaS platforms — pricing engines, inventory systems, third-party integrations, and production debugging at scale. Seeking full-time, embedded independent contractor (1099) roles with US and international companies.

Recently Staff at Effortless Ads on Google Cloud, driving technical direction for property-data ingestion, Google Ads campaign automation, and full-stack product engineering (1,000+ active campaigns; ~60% backend / 40% React). Prior senior individual contributor (IC) work at Drip (100–150M email/SMS events/month) and fullstack engineering at Shift (NASDAQ-listed used-car e-commerce marketplace, SFT). Earlier: CTO at BDS Turismo (B2B travel); co-founder of P2P Milhas (airline mileage marketplace); built the Ikarus flight-search API ecosystem.
Advanced English through years of daily work in US remote teams. Independent contractor for US/international companies since 2020.

impact.title: Selected Impact
content: At Effortless Ads, led architecture and implementation of a Google Cloud property-data scraper (Puppeteer, Bright Data, 2Captcha, OpenAI API) — thousands of properties processed daily at ~98% primary-source success; reduced recurring third-party data dependencies across 1,000+ Google Ads campaigns.

Built fullstack React portals at Effortless Ads (campaign management, user/company admin, property configuration, automation rules, ingestion/sync dashboards) on Google Ads API and Google Analytics API integrations with Stripe campaign payment flows.
Resolved intermittent failure of millions of marketing messages/month at Drip by diagnosing thread-safety issues in the Shopify gem under Sidekiq and migrating workloads to Resque.

content.role: Staff-level IC on a Google Cloud–hosted Google Ads automation platform. Translated product feature requests into end-to-end implementation strategy — evaluating system-wide impact, selecting technologies, external APIs/services, and code structure. Shared technical direction with peer engineer; mentored developers on codebase and architecture. Full-stack delivery (~60% backend / 40% React).
activities: Built admin and user-facing React portals with shared component patterns: Google Ads campaign management, user/company administration, property configuration, and automation rule setup.
Built operational dashboards for property-data ingestion, sync status monitoring, and campaign health across 1,000+ active campaigns.
Worked on core Google Ads API and Google Analytics API integrations; built proptech property-management features for end users and admins; Stripe integration for campaign payment flows.

Led architecture and implementation of property-data scraper on Google Cloud Functions (~2 months to v1) to reduce recurring third-party data dependencies for Effortless Ads ad generation, with client-authorized extraction of their own property marketing data.

Scraper pipeline: Puppeteer with Bright Data (proxy/captcha) and 2Captcha; link discovery via string-approximation algorithms and OpenAI API; multi-page parsing (meta tags, JSON-LD, regex, semantically chunked HTML with chunk classification → field extraction → normalization across 1–6 data sources); image extraction filtered via OpenAI API; ~98% primary-source success with ~2% fallback via Google Search to secondary listing-site sources when primary property sites failed; sync up to ~5 minutes per property; thousands of daily jobs on Cloud Functions and Cloud Run — reduced third-party integration dependency while preserving data consistency across 1,000+ active campaigns.
Delivered campaign automation and property-data ingestion on a fully Google Cloud–based platform.
Role ended Apr 2026 following post-acquisition team restructuring.

content.role: Full-stack product engineering at Shift Technologies (NASDAQ: SFT), a used-car e-commerce marketplace — direct consumer vehicle acquisition, digital inspection, home test-drive delivery, and no-haggle fixed pricing.
activities: Designed and implemented a vehicle-data scraping solution for an external platform, with data extraction authorized by the platform owner for Shift’s used-car marketplace operations.
Contributed to marketplace features and backend services through collaborative, subdivided team delivery.
Contract ended during company-wide contractor reductions amid financial restructuring.

content.role: Senior IC via Tarmac.IO at Drip, a marketing automation platform (~6,000 customers; 100–150M email/SMS events/month). Integration systems, event processing, and production debugging.
activities: Investigated long-standing production failures where millions of messages intermittently failed to send. Identified thread-safety issues in the Shopify gem (credential storage in module-level variables under Sidekiq); proposed and executed migration to Resque’s forked execution model.
Led design and implementation of Yotpo integration, processing millions of events monthly.
Built webhook-driven event systems, API clients, and Shopify / WooCommerce integrations.

content.context: Short-term role; transitioned to international remote contracts with US companies.
content.role: Backend development for a pharmacy marketplace — multi-tenant systems and delivery integrations.
activities: Designed and implemented Uber and Cabify delivery-provider API integrations.
Built tenant-isolated operational workflows on SpreeCommerce-based marketplace backend.

content.context: Co-founded as equity partner with BDS Turismo to enter the B2C segment. Shared backend systems (mileage inventory, purchase, operator-assisted ticket issuance) with separate B2B/B2C e-commerce fronts connected via REST API. Ceased operations in 2020 due to pandemic market conditions.
content.role: Co-founder, product strategy, system architecture, and full-stack development for a B2C airline-ticket marketplace.
activities: B2C scale: ~10 tickets/day and ~200K monthly flight searches before pandemic wind-down.
Built consumer-facing e-commerce (SpreeCommerce) on top of shared backend systems also used by BDS Turismo.
Implemented and connected shared services — mileage inventory, purchase workflows, operator-assisted ticket issuance — to the B2C storefront via REST API.
Integrated Ikarus flight search API ecosystem for pricing and search.

content.context: Hired to build B2B marketplace systems for travel agencies — same business model as MaxMilhas, serving agencies instead of end consumers. Later co-founded P2P Milhas (B2C only) as equity partner; shared backend systems with separate e-commerce fronts. P2P ceased operations in 2020 due to pandemic market conditions (Jul 2020); BDS continued through Dec 2021 (one-week gap before Shift).
content.role: CTO — technical leadership, system architecture, and product engineering. Led a team of 2–3 engineers (architecture, code review, mentoring, hiring).
activities: Platform scale: ~120 tickets/day and ~500K monthly flight searches for B2B travel agencies.

Designed and implemented shared backend systems: mileage inventory, purchase workflows, operator-assisted ticket issuance, and Cash Milhas (mileage inventory reconciliation) — with separate B2B (BDS Partner Platform) and B2C (P2P Milhas) SpreeCommerce storefronts connected via REST API.
Built real-time flight search/pricing engine (cash + mileage fares) and B2B airline-ticket distribution with financial consistency controls.
Integrated payment gateways: Mundipag, Stone, and Cielo (credit card) plus bank-slip (boleto) billing with bank integration.
Integrated Wintour (travel-agency financial ERP) via SOAP API for financial administration and Ikarus API ecosystem for flight search, pricing, and ticketing.

Chrome extension (JavaScript) for semi-automated mileage ticket issuance — aggregated passenger, inventory, and mileage-account data from internal systems and opened airline booking flows in-browser; human operator confirmed login, mileage redemption, and boarding-fee payment by credit card.
Configured DigitalOcean infrastructure and deployment pipelines.

content.context: Founded after leaving MaxMilhas to build a software services company. Evolved the flight pricing scraper into a reusable API platform plus e-commerce solutions for travel companies.
activities: Designed and implemented the Ikarus Flight Search API — real-time cash airfare and mileage redemption pricing aggregation with API-first architecture.
Delivered ticketing, integration APIs, and custom e-commerce systems for marketplace clients.
Platform later became the shared pricing and search layer for BDS Turismo and P2P Milhas.

content.context: Early-stage B2C marketplace buying mileage inventory from individuals and reselling flights at competitive prices via real-time fare comparison against airline-direct pricing.
activities: Contracted: Built real-time flight pricing scraper and customer-facing fare comparison engine (cash vs. mileage-based fares) — core to the company’s conversion model.
Employed: Worked on the PHP monolith handling mileage inventory and marketplace operations.
Software development, database maintenance, and web data extraction for client projects.
